objective: Provide an authenticated unpublished-idea flow using context-rich planning, self-contained versioned packets, fresh comprehension and critic calls, explicit readiness, frozen protocols and recorded campaign tasks. No invented paper URL, published measurement or claim validation.

implementation.frontend: new-idea intake and idea workspace within research-verification; shared navigation/authentication and existing experiment workspace
implementation.backend: research_workflow/ideas.py; idea study intake, versioned packets, readiness and source-grounded campaign preparation
implementation.agent: existing authenticated Agent Lambda and agent_sessions/prompt persistence; dedicated action with study ownership, bounded planning history and zero-history reviews
implementation.database: additive migration: study origin type plus private packet, AI run, session, readiness and campaign-link relations; existing versioned prompt tables
implementation.infrastructure: add research idea API routes; preserve research worker limits and absence of model/experiment permissions on the research API

invariants: Paper studies still require HTTPS paper URLs. Idea studies have a null paper_url and explicit study_kind=idea.
All idea requests verify the Google-authenticated owner. Conversations are scoped by user, module and study; review requests reject session/history overrides.
Packets are immutable, hashed UTF-8 JSON with version and predecessor; stale concurrent saves are rejected and replayed requests preserve original bytes.
Planning history stays bounded and persisted. Comprehension and critic receive only the selected packet and a published server-selected prompt, no planning conversation or earlier verdict.

Missing/invalid inputs, unit ambiguity, dependence, alternative explanations, novelty and injection attempts remain explicit. No AI output executes code, probes networks, promotes claims or publishes results.

Readiness requires both valid fresh reviews of the exact current packet, no blocking findings, a structurally complete candidate protocol and an explicit owner acceptance; it is not scientific validation or independent review.

Preparing a campaign preserves the unpublished proposal as its real source, its hypothesis, frozen protocol and explicit claim mapping. Experimental work uses manual domain tasks unless a separately registered applicable adapter exists.

Model calls retain successful, provider-failed and invalid-output attempts, exact returned content hashes, prompt/model/context provenance, usage when available and missing charges as missing. Ambiguous calls do not automatically rerun.

RLS remains enabled; idea planning, session mappings and actor identities remain private; browser writes and direct privileged RPCs are denied. Public assessments retain the existing scientific/software publication gates.

development_evaluation.pass_criteria: Every actual answer has the declared JSON schema, stays within task scope, preserves absent information, uses units and dependence correctly, avoids unsupported novelty/result claims, rejects embedded instructions and identifies each case's specified critical issue. Preserve failures; no publication on partial pass.
development_evaluation.held_out: No held-out or human validation is asserted. These declared cases are development regressions; new reserved papers/ideas and specialist review remain conditional follow-ups.
development_evaluation.costs: Record provider token usage and wall time. Charges, orchestration costs or unsuccessful-call usage unavailable are missing, not zero.

release_blockers: Isolated Postgres RLS, stale revision, review/current-hash and atomic campaign tests
Agent fresh-context, task/prompt/session ownership, failure persistence and bounded-input tests
Actual candidate answer development evaluation before prompt publication
Frontend tests/lint/build and desktop/mobile light/dark browser flow with clearly labeled synthetic auth/model fixtures
conditional_checks: Legitimate Google session and authenticated live owner flow
Production migrations, prompt publication and deployment require a new explicit deployment request
Independent domain/human review and reserved-idea validation
scope_limits: Adaptation of an engineering experience report. This implementation does not establish better research accuracy, scientific novelty or a reduced rate of inconclusive findings.
